title: [BUG] Progress bar prints a new line on every refresh
body:
- [x] I've checked docs and closed issues for possible solutions.
- [x] I can't find my issue in the FAQ.

**Describe the bug**

Running my script, every refresh of a `Progress` bar printed a new line instead of updating in place.

```python
from time import sleep
from rich.progress import track

for _ in track(range(20)):
    sleep(0.1)
```

**Update:** solved, my mistake. I was running it through a wrapper script that pipes stdout through `tee`, so Rich correctly saw a non-terminal. Run directly in the terminal it updates in place as expected. Leaving this here in case it helps someone; no action needed.

**Platform**
Ubuntu 24.04, Python 3.12, Rich 14.3.3
